line.comment: * This script runs only once at gamestart. Called by Mayhem.GameCreator.Setup.
* Terraforming rarity:
* Common: 74%, decreasing by 1% per common roll, down to 70%.
* Uncommon: 20%
* Anomalous: 5%
* Rare: 1%, increasing by 1% per common roll, up to 5%.
* Rare rolls reset the probabilities to their starting values.
* Add-Ons 2.1: Echoes of the Hive.
* The first rare effect generated becomes the Ancient Kha'ak Hive.
* Only one Hive can generate per galaxy.
* Gaia Worlds require de jure territory or Terran Memory.
* Expanded 2.2: Maximum two Recycler effects per sector.
* Effect array, currently initialized with a size of 1 unless there is a need to expand the array.
* [0] = effect ID
* COMMON EFFECTS
* Each common roll increases the rare chance by 1%, up to a maximum rare chance of 5%.
* UNCOMMON EFFECTS
* ANOMALOUS EFFECTS
* RARE EFFECTS
* Reset the common chance after a rare roll.
* The first rare roll becomes the unique Ancient Kha'ak Hive.
* Standard rare effects: indices 0-6.
* Gaia is index 7 and requires an eligible sector.
* The RNG upper bound is exclusive if a variable is used, inclusive if a constant is used.
* Expanded 2.2: Exclude Recycler (index 0) after two have spawned in this sector.
* Shift the eligible indices to skip Recycler.
